grammar.summary: 本课学习过去进行时背景与 prefer...to 结构。

points.title: prefer + 名词 + to + 名词
points.explanation: Roy prefers his new car to his old one. 注意 to 是介词：prefer doing to doing 也可。

examples.en: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi.
examples.cn: Roy Trenton 过去开出租车。

points.title: while 进行时 + when 突发动作
points.explanation: While he was driving along, he saw two thieves. 背景进行时与突发过去时的经典搭配。

examples.en: The thieves' car was badly damaged.
